part5.q: The manager will review the report ____ Friday.
part5.explain: ‘on Friday’가 날짜를 나타내는 전형적인 전치사 표현입니다.

part5.q: Our team is responsible ____ handling customer inquiries.
Please send the revised contract ____ email by the end of the day.
part5.explain: ‘via email’은 ‘~을 통해’라는 의미로 전치사 via를 사용합니다.

part5.q: The conference will be held ____ the new headquarters.
part5.explain: ‘at the headquarters’는 특정 장소를 가리킬 때 쓰는 전치사입니다.

part5.q: She was promoted ____ recognition of her outstanding performance.
part5.explain: ‘for recognition’은 ‘인정 때문에’라는 의미로 전치사 for가 적절합니다.

passage.title: Request for Updated Project Timeline
passage.body:
Subject: Request for Updated Project Timeline

Dear Mr. Lee,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to ask for an updated timeline for the Alpha‑Beta integration project. As we discussed in last week’s meeting, the client has requested a revised delivery date due to recent changes in their internal schedule.

Could you please provide the new milestones, including the expected completion date for the testing phase, by Thursday, March 12? Additionally, if there are any resource constraints that might affect the schedule, kindly let us know so we can adjust our plans accordingly.

Your prompt response will help us keep the client informed and maintain our commitment to quality service. Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
Sofia Martinez
Project Coordinator

questions.q: What does the writer request from Mr. Lee?
questions.explain: 본문에서 ‘I am writing to ask for an updated timeline…’이라고 명시되어 있어 최신 일정표를 요청하는 것이 맞습니다.
questions.evidence: I am writing to ask for an updated timeline for the Alpha‑Beta integration project.

questions.q: By when does the writer need the new milestones?
questions.explain: ‘by Thursday, March 12’라는 문구가 정확한 마감일을 제시하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What specific phase's completion date is mentioned?
questions.explain: 본문에 ‘expected completion date for the testing phase’라고 명시되어 있어 테스트 단계가 언급됩니다.
questions.evidence: expected completion date for the testing phase

questions.q: Why does the writer emphasize a prompt response?
questions.explain: ‘Your prompt response will help us keep the client informed’이라는 문장에서 고객에게 정보를 제공하기 위해 신속한 회신이 필요함을 알 수 있습니다.
questions.evidence: Your prompt response will help us keep the client informed

confusable.diff: farther = 물리적 거리(더 멀리) / further = 추가의·더 나아가(추상)

vocab.tip: 정답은 동의어 치환 — 지문 단어와 같은 뜻의 다른 표현이 정답입니다.
